caption: Andrea Lubina Al-Nurribin enjoys her meal post-food-preparation at 2407 W 19th St. on April 26, 2024. Volunteers have dinner together after they all finish packaging food for the unhoused.

A counter-protester stands outside the DePaul University Quad and confronts protesters at the encampment on May 5, 2024. Counter-protesters chanted, “Show your face,” in response to the encampment members wearing masks.

Nick Miska heats up the glass to extend the end of the tail to make a loop for the necklace at the Ikonic Glass mobile studio on the corner of Armitage and Kenmore Ave. on May 18, 2024. Since this is one of the easiest shaped to glassblow, Miska chose to teach it to people at the Mayfest.

Volunteers from Ojala Foundation pray, converse and fill food containers at 2407 W 19th Street as they prepare to head out into the neighborhood. They start arriving at the location around 8:00 PM to prepare meals and have their dinner before heading out into the neighborhood.

Students watch the Solar Eclipse on April 8, 2024 in front of the DePaul Center Loop Campus. Many students made their way to the bottom of the building after the terrace had closed entrances for the official watch party.

Audience members react positively to Anabelle Rivera’s performance of “Rejection on the Playground” at the 14 East Live on May 23, 2024, at DePaul University’s Daley Building. This event takes place once a year and features performances from students of the Reporting of 14 East Magazine class.

A protestor stands on a pillar and waves a Palestinian flag outside the DePaul Univeristy Quad on May 5, 2024. Members of the encampment barricaded the fence of the quad to ensure counter-protestors wouldn’t be able to enter.

Adnan Yarkhan sets up containers of chicken and rice to be distributed while Araceli Espinoza greets Yesenia Roman at 2407 W 19th St. on April 26, 2024. Volunteers from Ojala Foundation stand in an assembly line, filling individual containers before putting them in boxes.

Gia Clarke plays her original song “palatable agony” on the electric guitar at 14 East Live on May 23, 2024, at DePaul University’s Daley Building. The song’s lyrics focussed on the ‘27 Club’ and how artists burn out too quickly.

A police officer stands guard outside the entrance of the DePaul University Quad on May 5, 2024. Officers had lined up outside of the Quad to barricade entrances and ensure that there weren’t any physical altercations.
